verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents its own automatic onboarding and offboarding workflows, identity-lifecycle automation, and conditional access that revokes access with no manual intervention, so some automations do run in the background. That support is limited to identity and access events. The API and PowerShell bulk operations are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general user-configurable automation or workflow builder, recurring schedules or triggers beyond lifecycle events, agentic or AI-driven autonomous execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: establish automatic onboarding and offboarding workflows
